answer: Like a marble floor that only holds weight when each slab is real, an agent economy can require every identity to lock 750 POA as a work bond plus complete 20 verified paid tasks before its votes count. A crystal-clear ledger then slashes the bond of any identity caught attesting its own clones. An attacker spinning up 1,000 fake agents must freeze 750,000 POA and fund 20,000 real tasks, while a zephyr-light honest newcomer pays only the single 750 POA bond it gets back after 60 honest days.
